result.title: Seeing Right, Writing Wrong: Where Short Chain-of-Thought Breaks Spatial VQA
result.summary: Asking a vision-language model (VLM) to think step by step often makes it worse at spatial questions, even though the image stays in context. We show that short chain-of-thought (CoT) turns a perception problem into a transcription problem. Once a VLM writes a spatial relation, its answer follows that sentence instead of the image, so whether CoT helps or hurts depends largely on whether the written relation is more accurate than answering directly. Studying 15 open VLMs (2B-38B) and six frontier closed models, we rule out token count, turn format, and visual forgetting in open models and trace the failure through three stages. First, writing re-weights visual cues, weakening a "lower is closer" shortcut in all 13 open models tested but also discarding valid cues, which produces false relations. Second, the written text takes over. With the model's own conclusion-removed rationale held fixed, swapping in an opposite-depth image moves the answer by 2-9 points on rendered twins (vs. up to 77 for direct answers) and by 3.0-3.4 points on average on natural photographs (vs. 20.5-69.6). Third, the concluding sentence can invert even a true relation, mainly on converse questions. Together, false relations and conclusion mis-mapping account for four in five CoT losses. Scale does not remove this bottleneck: Qwen3-VL-32B shows the same pattern. Frontier closed models are not hurt: they write relations as accurately as they answer, and three of six re-check the image after writing. The three queried with reasoning off lock in like open models, so re-grounding co-occurs with answer-turn reasoning; we identify answer-step re-grounding as the step open VLMs lack. In a single-model pilot, fine-tuning on fixed rationales with image-determined labels restores it on natural photographs. We open-sourced all our datasets and code at https://ming-zch.github.io/seeing-right-writing-wrong.

AI.brief_summary: 论文系统诊断短 chain-of-thought 为何反而降低 VLM 的空间 VQA 表现：在 15 个开源模型与 6 个前沿闭源模型上排除 token 数、轮次格式和视觉遗忘，将失败拆为「书写改变视觉线索权重」「文本接管理答案」「结论句误映射」三阶段，并通过固定 rationale、替换反向深度图像等干预量化文本对答案的支配程度；同时指出闭源模型会在作答步骤重新回看图像，并用固定 rationale 微调的初步实验尝试补上该步骤。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接对应「答案是否真正使用视觉证据」与信息坍缩问题，其「answer-step re-grounding」缺失的分析可为 THINK/LOOK/STOP 中 LOOK 的收益与必要性提供可核查的因果证据。
